approval_entry.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the actual full-resolution yellow mascot EDIT TARGET from a successful exact service retry. Image 2 is the exact original game portrait and the sole authority for the background. Image 3 is the user mascot identity reference. Restore ONLY the original painted background that was mistakenly removed. The original is a complete rectangular portrait canvas with a pale warm grey/beige painted backdrop and its own shading/vignette. Its actual RGBA has NO fully transparent pixels. Fill the missing areas behind the head and shoulders with that same original painted background all the way to all four original canvas edges. This is NOT a transparent cutout request. The complete portrait rectangle, head, hair, clothing and background must be OPAQUE; no transparent holes, halo, alpha fade or bare checkerboard. Preserve Image 1's yellow mascot head, exact source hair, eyebrows, source-only moustache or clean-shaven face, eyewear, headgear, visible insignia and garment, pose, expression, gaze, head size, original crop and full output resolution. Keep the compact rounded head seated directly in the fitted broad original collar with no long neck, clipping or cream bib. Do not add or replace symbols, accessories, clothes or text. Retain the exact source portrait aspect ratio. No photograph frame or note, no comparison layout, no extra figure. Final output requirement: restore Image 2's original painted background over the entire portrait rectangle; opaque RGBA canvas, not a freestanding bust.
Output alpha: preserve genuine transparent RGBA outside the original asset's outer silhouette. Retain all original opaque content, including any existing background or dark vignette that is part of this source; do not erase it into alpha holes. Where the original exterior is transparent, do not invent a new solid canvas, halo or studio backdrop. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and portrait crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
